169317.overview:
The game features a B-movie horror theme. Players have to go through the Six Tales Of Terror to level up the Stiff-o-meter. These are: Eyes Of The Bony Beast, Terror From The Crate, the Stiff In The Coffin, the Monster's Lab, Night Of The Leapers, and the Return Of The Deadheads. The interactive backbox contains a player controlled spinning spider. It is used to collect unique features and start special modes. Scared Stiff uses the DCS Sound System.

Scared Stiff was exhibited at the 1996 AMOA show in Dallas, with Cassandra Peterson present in her Elvira identity to promote the game.

When Scared Stiff was introduced in 1996, it was designed to have moving rubber boogieman figures mounted over the slingshots. These were designed to move forward with the kicker each time the ball hit the slingshot. The game's ROM also allowed for the boogiemen to 'dance' to the music during the Boogie Man Boogie mode by kicking with the music. Very late in production, this feature was removed because the figures' arms were thought to eventually break off. An opening between the feet of the slingshot plastics is still present on all production machines, as well as an entry in the game's manual about the feature. Additionally, the code in the machine's ROM supports the feature. Because of this, many hobbyists have added the boogiemen figure modifications to their machines.

196231.overview: Strip Joker Poker is a 2013 mod by SLAMT1LT for the Future Pinball version of Gottlieb's 1978 table "Joker Poker".

196398.overview:
Boo! Ghosts, skeletons and creepy sounds make this table a thrilling haunted house adventure.

Spooky is a late-era generation two solid state pinball table, and one of the last released by Zaccaria. It arrived as the company faced financial decline, resulting in a low production run—estimated at only 60 to 100 units—making it one of the rarest Zaccaria machines ever built. 

The table's most famous feature is the mechanical animation in the backbox: an owl whose eyes blink open and closed. The cabinet features a distinct "Ms. Nosferatu" face on the side, accompanied by vibrant neon colors.

196399.overview:
Enter the cosmic realm of the Star God! Harness divine power, activate starbursts, and light up the galaxy in this mystic sci-fi table.

Star God is an early, well-regarded solid-state table by Zaccaria. It is characterized by a central snake-on-a-sword artwork and focuses on drop targets, a single pop bumper, and a spinner, with a high-stakes, "blocked" playfield layout.

216511.overview: Secrets of the Deep is a pinball table that released with the launch of Pinball FX2 as part of the Core Collection, and was re-released in all subsequent Pinball FX games. The table follows a crew of deep sea researchers, evading danger as they encounter shipwrecks full of priceless treasure on their quest to find the lost city of Atlantis.

423512.overview: Introducing VPW's latest creation, SpongeBob's Bikini Bottom Pinball by the original table author, Skillshot! Dive into the deep sea fun with your favorite sponge and friends in this exciting new table. Immerse yourself in Bikini Bottom's quirky world with innovative gameplay and stunning graphics. Get ready for a pinball adventure like no other!

448322.overview: Star Wars: Darth Vader is a pinball table based on the iconic Sith Lord Darth Vader as one of a multitude of Star Wars Zen Pinball tables available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. This table is one of the three tables in the Balance of the Force pack and covers the history of the galaxy's most feared and infamous Sith Lord, from the completion of his life support armor to his eventual redemption by his son, Luke Skywalker.

448325.overview:
Based on events from Star Wars: The Force Awakens, players will experience unforgettable moments from the film on two action-packed pinball tables. Team up with the Resistance to fight against the First Order alongside Rey, Finn, Poe, General Leia, and Han Solo in the Star Wars Pinball: The Force Awakens Table! Take command of the First Order as you travel through hyperspace on board a Star Destroyer and restore order to a galaxy far, far away on the Star Wars Pinball: Might of the First Order table!

The table retells the events of the film through twelve missions, each formatted in an "on-rails" style designed to help the player see as much of the game's features as possible.

448335.overview: Star Wars: Han Solo is a pinball table themed off Han Solo, originally released for the Star Wars Pinball: Heroes Within pack for Pinball FX2. The table gives the player an opportunity to relive significant moments in Han Solo's journey from the original trilogy, from his days as a smuggler to becoming an unlikely ally of the Rebel Alliance in their struggle to overthrow the Galactic Empire and restore the Republic.

448363.overview:
Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi is one of the three tables released for the Star Wars Pinball: Balance of the Force DLC pack, originally released for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2 and later ported to Pinball FX3. The table adapts the conclusion to the original Star Wars trilogy, as the Rebel Alliance escapes the clutches of Jabba, and Luke & Vader are forced to come to terms against a greater evil.

Set in the forest of the Endor moon, players join Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, Princess Leia, Lando Calrissian, R2-D2, and C-3PO to defeat the Sith and restore peace in the galaxy!

The table is packed with interactive 3D objects inspired by the film including an AT-ST, Speeder bike, Death Star II hologram, TIE fighters, Tydirium shuttle and a Shield generator!

448368.overview:
We have a mission for you. The Empire has a major weapon and we need to know how to destroy it. You have been recruited to a small band of rebel fighters to restore hope to the galaxy.

Table features:
- Rogue One’s adventures unfold in 10 story-related game modes, each with completely different playfield toys.
- Avoid stormtrooper detection in stealth missions!
- Engage in firefights and close combat in action-oriented game modes!
- Face Orson Krennic and his death troopers in an intense multiball mode!
- Try to evade the footsteps of the mighty stomping AT-ACT walker!
- Assist the heroes by navigating the U-wing or by shooting down TIE strikers as the ship’s gunner!

448377.overview:
South Park: Super-Sweet Pinball was one of two tables in the South Park Pinball table pack, based on the animated Comedy Central TV series. Originally released for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX2, and as a standalone mobile app in October 2014, the table follows the absurd, unusual lives of the many residents of South Park. It uses voice clips from the episodes and the same 2D cardboard cut-out style for the animated characters. Following the release of Pinball FX3 in 2017, this table was discontinued due to licensing restrictions, but can still be played if it was bought when available.

This is the second ever pinball machine to be based on the South Park TV series - the first being a physical pinball machine released by SEGA Pinball in 1999, later known as Stern Pinball. Both tables were designed with support from the crew of the TV series, but play completely differently from each other and have very different layouts.

There are different missions based on the characters. Stan needs to kiss Wendy, but a right orbit needs to be hit to prevent him from throwing up. Randy needs to defeat Bat Dad who appears as a animated character on the table by hitting him. The boys can also hunt down ManBearPig. Kyle has his own multiball for a jackpot based around Mr. Hankey where the balls change into poo. Cartman has an alien probe and the spaceships of the aliens need to be defeated. He also throws cheesy poofs on the table with a large score for each hit. Chef is on the left side of the table and needs help from the boys for some romantic encounters. Kenny hides in different places on the table and needs to be targeted. You also can get the children on the school bus and Terrance and Phillip are on the right side with their own Canada lane. The ball can be taken to the mini table from the beginning for Sarcastaball where the ball changes into a red balloon, floating slowly. Each completed mission lights a South Park letter at the bottom of the table. When all missions are completed the wizard mode is activated.

Next to the mini table after launch, the main table has a regular set of flippers at the bottom, three outlanes on the left and two on the right, with Timmy letters to collect. There is another flipper near the top left to reach the main ramps on the right. A large loop reaches around the table and the spinners are located on the right. There are many targets in the centre area near the back.

455336.overview:
It's a strike! Knock down the targets like bowling pins and ride the score lane to a perfect score.

Strike is an enjoyable but fairly simple solid state pinball table with a bowling theme, released by Zaccaria in September 1978.

The playfield is defined by its focus on precision, featuring two flippers, three pop bumpers, and a central eight-bank drop target assembly designed to mimic bowling pins. Players earn points primarily by clearing the drop target banks. 

While themed around bowling, the aesthetic reflects the late 1970s transition from electro-mechanical (EM) to solid-state technology, emphasizing "aiming" rather than complex ramps found in later eras.

460377.overview:
Shock, released in July 1979 by Taito do Brasil, is a Brazilian solid-state adaptation of the popular Williams Electronics table, Flash. 

During the late 1970s, strict Brazilian import laws effectively prohibited the entry of foreign-made pinball machines. To meet local demand, Taito do Brasil (a subsidiary of the Japanese company) began "cloning" successful designs from major manufacturers like Williams, Bally, and Gottlieb. Shock was one such machine, directly modeled after the 1978/1979 Williams hit, Flash.

460379.overview: Space Poker is a 4-player solid-state pinball table manufactured by LTD do Brasil Diversões Eletrônicas Ltda. in 1982. It is essentially a Brazilian copy of the 1980 Williams Alien Poker game, utilizing the same playfield layout but produced for the South American market.

460380.overview: Snake Machine is a rare solid-state pinball table manufactured by Taito do Brasil, released in January 1982. It is primarily known as a Brazilian-made clone of the 1981 Stern pinball machine Viper, featuring a similar playfield layout and serpent-themed aesthetics.

460452.overview:
Released in 1979 by Taito do Brasil, Sultan is a Brazilian solid-state pinball machine known as a modified clone of the 1978 Gottlieb Sinbad. Originally featuring four flippers, Taito modified the design to two flippers with lower slingshots to address high ball-loss rates between flippers. 

While based on Sinbad, Sultan has a unique Brazilian-produced playfield and cabinet art featuring a Middle Eastern theme. It is a drop-target heavy game, focusing on clearing banks to multiply bonuses.

460479.overview: Sure Shot, released in December 1981 by Taito do Brasil, is a solid-state machine known as a Brazilian clone of Bally's famous Eight Ball machine from 1977.

462481.overview: Samba was released in 1976 by LTD do Brasil and features a dancing theme. It is an electro-mechanical machine, released during the industry's transition toward solid-state electronics. Modern enthusiasts primarily encounter this table through digital recreations on platforms like Visual Pinball X, as physical units remain rare outside of South America.

462492.overview:
The Saloon pinball machine, released by Taito do Brasil in 1978, is a rare digital-era table known for its unique "slot machine" scoring mechanics. While Taito do Brasil often produced clones of American tables, Saloon is a distinct part of their early solid-state lineup. 

The central feature of Saloon is a central display that functions like a three-reel slot machine, triggering specific prizes when three equal values are rolled:

• 111: Lights the side lanes and upper targets.
• 222: Lights both lower and upper targets.
• 333: Activates all Double Bonus lights.
• 444 / 888: Activates the spinners for the remainder of the current ball.
• 555 / 777 / 999: Lights the "Special" and upper targets.
• The Big Prize: If the central display reaches 888, a large "When Lit" light in the center turns on. Hitting the upper arc rollover at this time awards 20,000 points.

462683.overview:
Space Patrol (1978) is a rare electro-mechanical pinball machine produced by Taito do Brasil, often operating with digital-style scoring. As one of Taito's earliest releases, it is considered a clone of the Recel "Lady Luck" (1978) table but features unique, customized playfield and backglass artwork. The theme draws inspiration from 1950s space comics. 

It is one of the hardest Taito do Brasil tables to find today. This is largely because many of Taito's early machines were destroyed or scrapped when newer microprocessed tables were introduced. The machine's rarity is so high that for many years, no photos of the original playfield existed in the pinball community. Digital recreations have had to rely on a single known picture of the backglass to "re-imagine" the playfield and rules.

467984.overview: Splosion Man captured! The World is safe... At least, that's what they thought! Straight from the science lab, Ms. Splosion Man is out of control, even more dangerous...and pinker than her better half. She's on a mission to save Splosion Man from the grasp of the giant robot, the Mighty Eternal. The Scientists will try anything to stop her during this perilous quest. Ms. Splosion Man will Splode herself through Energy Walls, Electric Beam Hazards, Rollerbots, and hundreds of barrels and Zip lines to reach her goal and save Splosion Man.

467985.overview:
Loaded with the iconic characters that revolutionized the fighting genre, "Street Fighter II" comes alive in ZEN Pinball and Pinball FX. With this new table, players will experience the legendary Street Fighter franchise combined with the arcade thrills of traditional pinball employing cutting-edge visuals, true-to-life ball and table physics and new innovative features not found in any other pinball game.

Features:

Enter the World Warrior Championship fighting as Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li, and Guile and battle against Sagat, Evil Ryu, Vega, and Balrog, then win the final round of the championship against M. Bison!

Discover combo shots, animated punches, kicks and special moves as you fight against opponents using ramps and a variety of orbit shot

Multiple in-game challenges featuring objects, art and memorable items from Street Fighter II
Table soundtrack, sound effects and voices from the original Street Fighter II

Release History:

The table was released on November 12 2008 as a paid DLC table for Pinball FX on XBOX Live. Almost a year later, on August 20 2009, it was made available as the first downloadable expansion table for the Zen Pinball game on the PlayStation Network. It was subsequently released for Pinball FX2 on XBOX 360 and XBOX ONE.

468511.overview: Shaman is one of the first four pinball tables available in Zen Pinball when it first released for the PlayStation 3, re-released in the Zen Classics pack in later Pinball FX releases. The table is based on shamanism, depicting a witch doctor demonstrating the power of the elements on his tribe.

468516.overview: Sorcerer's Lair is one of the early Zen Pinball original tables, first released as DLC for Zen Pinball on the PlayStation 3, and made available as a free starter table in all installments of the Pinball FX series starting with the release of Pinball FX 2. It is a fantasy-horror pinball table, depicting the story of a young boy and his sister's journey into a haunted mansion to outwit a mischievous sorcerer with the help of a mysterious ghost girl named Whisper.

468523.overview:
South Park: Butters' Very Own Pinball Game is a DLC pinball table first released in October 2014 for Pinball FX2 (Xbox 360, Xbox One, Windows) and Zen Pinball 2 (PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita). On 12th October 2023 it was re-released with the same name for Pinball FX (2023) on all recent consoles and PC.

It is based on the South Park animated TV series with Butters as the main character. It uses voice clips from the episodes and the same 2D cardboard cut-out style for the animated characters.

The game consists of five main modes. When these are completed Imaginationland is unlocked in the wizard mode with a four-ball multiball. Butters often appears on the left side of the screen on a stage with different costumes. He can travel to Hawaii for his Hapa Noa ceremony in a multiball mode where fifteen shots needs to be made in three minutes. In The Ungroundable he becomes a vampire who needs to collect accessories. In Marjorine he dresses up as a girl to steal a future telling device from the girls' sleepover. In Last of the Meheecans he helps Mexicans cross the border into Texas. The final mode called Chaos vs Coon & Friends takes you to a mini table away from the main table. Using two flippers Butters needs to assemble his superhero team. There are also various letters to collect for smaller bonuses along with a biker multiball and the South Park boys who appear on the table as their anime counterparts.

The table has a regular set of flippers at the bottom with very few targets near the bottom and the middle part, making it a speedy table with many ramps near the back. There is another right flipper near the centre of the table in the back, used to reach a circle area where the ball can be spun around to hit targets. When 50 targets are hit the mission mode is enabled. Just behind the top flipper is a sinkhole where the ball can be locked. There are three outlanes on each side. During the Hapa Noa multiball mode balls are launched from a slingshot with two palm trees near the bottom left part of the table.

468537.overview:
Son of Zeus is one of two original pinball tables in the Carnivals and Legends pack, the first add-on pack for Pinball FX 3. The table is based on the Greek myth of the Twelve Labors of Hercules, depicting demigod Hercules being challenged by his deranged mother Hera, queen of the Greek gods, to take on the labors and earn his place in the Greek pantheon.

An earlier pinball adaptation of the Hercules legend was released by Atari in 1979, simply titled Hercules; the table is notable for being the largest physical pinball machine.

468561.overview: Sky Pirates: Treasures of the Clouds is one of the three Zen Originals that released with the launch of the Pinball FX reboot in March 2022. This steampunk-inspired table puts the player in command of the Manragoth, a ship operated by Captain Ronnie and his drone assistant Monkey, as they search for treasure.

468570.overview:
Spider-Man is one of the first four Marvel pinball tables released in 2010, originally released for Zen Pinball and Pinball FX before being ported to further Zen pinball collections. Based on the ubiquitous Marvel superhero Spider-Man, created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko, this table depicts his efforts to balance his life between fighting supervillains in New York City and making a decent living as a newspaper reporter for The Daily Bugle and building a romantic relationship with Mary Jane Watson.

This is the third known major pinball machine to be based on Spider-Man, following Gottlieb's The Amazing Spider-Man released in 1980 and Stern's 2007 pinball adaptation of Sony Pictures and Sam Raimi's 2002-2007 Spider-Man trilogy.

468583.overview:
Snoopy was the first new Animated Heroes table released following the launch of Zen Pinball Party, originally released on October 29th, 2021, and subsequently ported to Pinball FX in February 2023. The table features Snoopy's many imaginary personas, including the Flying Ace and astronaut, and highlights his interactions with the rest of the gang from the Peanuts comic strip, such as Charlie Brown and Woodstock.

Snoopy was also the first Pinball FX table designed by Daniel "Dolby" Vigh.

468675.overview:
Guide Zen Studios F.C. in their quest to become Super League Champions.

Table Features:

- Zen Studios F.C. is ready for victory! Guide your team of players sporting developer likenesses
- Launch your attack and score on the mini-playfield
- Master player skills in several different multiball modes each tied to must-have talents in football
- Fill your trophy cabinet with your progress saved between games
- Reach the Golden Goal Wizard Mode and shoot for stellar scores

The table was first released for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2 in 2022, and was later ported to Pinball FX in 2024.

468679.overview:
Celebrates the famous Kenner action figures of major classic Star Wars characters. Collect them all!

Classic Collectibles is one of the two Star Wars pinball tables originally released as an exclusive for Star Wars Pinball VR, later ported into the Pinball FX reboot. Using the events of the original trilogy as a backdrop, the table challenges the player to collect Kenner's many action figures based on the series.

The machine takes heavy inspiration from Data East's 1992 Star Wars pinball machine. Both games' art packages feature a heavy comic-book influence.

468680.overview:
Experience the vision of the newest trilogy of Star Trek blockbuster movies in this epic table. Join Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the Enterprise on their mission to discover new civilizations, form alliances and neutralize threats to the Federation.

Released for Pinball FX on 7 December, 2023 as part of the three-table Star Trek™ Pinball pack. The collection features tables based on the Kelvin Timeline, Star Trek: Discovery, and Deep Space Nine.

468683.overview:
Travel to the edges of the final frontier and arrive at the space station Deep Space 9! Use your pinball skills to lead the crew and Captain Benjamin Sisko in ending the Dominion War.

Released for Pinball FX on 7 December, 2023 as part of the three-table Star Trek™ Pinball pack. The collection features tables based on the Kelvin Timeline, Star Trek: Discovery, and Deep Space Nine.

468684.overview:
Michael Burnham and the shipmates of the U.S.S. Discovery rely on your pinball prowess, as you play through iconic moments from the first four seasons of the series. Make contact with the residents of 10-C and utilize the time loop for victory!

Released for Pinball FX on 7 December, 2023 as part of the three-table Star Trek™ Pinball pack. The collection features tables based on the Kelvin Timeline, Star Trek: Discovery, and Deep Space Nine.

468691.overview:
Based on the first season of the acclaimed Disney+ series The Mandalorian, this table explores the journey of a mysterious Mandalorian warrior and bounty hunter in the early years of the New Republic.

The Mandalorian is one of the two Star Wars pinball tables originally released as an exclusive for Star Wars Pinball VR, later ported into the Pinball FX reboot. The table retells the events of season 1 of the eponymous series.

Stern Pinball put out a physical pinball machine based on the series in 2021. The games have no relation to each other outside of theme.

469109.overview:
Lead Liverpool FC to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots. The Liverpool table also features a crowd rendition of "You'll Never Walk Alone" as its unique theme music.

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469110.overview:
Lead Arsenal FC to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots.

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469161.overview:
Star Wars: Ahch-To Island is a pinball table about Rey's visit to Luke Skywalker's island monastery on Ahch-To as one of a multitude of Star Wars Zen Pinball tables available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. 

This table is one of two tables in the The Last Jedi pack and showcases the typical activities of Luke's monastery and Rey and Chewbacca's efforts to convince him to take a stand against the First Order during the events of the film Star Wars: The Last Jedi, the second installment of the sequel trilogy and the eighth overall installment of the Skywalker Saga.

469162.overview:
Lead AS Roma to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots.

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469164.overview:
Star Wars: Masters of the Force is a pinball table based on the intense clash between the light and dark sides of the Force throughout the Star Wars saga, originally released in the Heroes Within DLC pack for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX 2. 

The player gets to relive the most intense lightsaber battles between the Jedi and the Sith, and can choose to either support one side of the Force or fulfill the prophecy of the balance between the two.

469166.overview:
Star Wars: Boba Fett is one of the first three Star Wars pinball tables released in 2013 for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, and later for Pinball FX3 and Pinball FX. It is based on the adventures of the infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett, whom the Galactic Empire once paid to pursue fleeing rebels in Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back.

Instead of having traditional mode-based rules, the goal of Boba Fett is to complete bounties. The player can choose between two different sets of bounties, and must complete the 100 million bounty for either set to get a chance at the wizard mode, where Boba Fett captures the crew of the Millennium Falcon at Bespin and escapes the Sarlacc. Completed bounties can be replayed for extra points and chances to lock balls for Mandalorian Multiball.

There are two different sets of bounties available: Empire bounties, and Jabba bounties. Empire bounties are started by shooting the empire loop to spell EMPIRE; while Jabba bounties are started by hitting the captive ball with a strong shot, then shooting the sinkhole behind it to spell HUTTS. (The minimum number of shots required to start a bounty is 3, while the maximum is 7; depending on how much time the player takes between making shots, fewer letters will be collected and more shots will have to be made.)

At the start of the game, the first five letters of Boba Fett's name are lit. To collect the last three letters and qualify the wizard mode, the player must complete any combination of either side's three unique bounties. (For example, completing the first unique Empire bounty means that progress cannot be gained for beating the first unique Jabba bounty, although the payload and lock will still be awarded.) After the wizard mode has been won, the player will have to collect the first five letters through completing a combination of the five initial bounties; these can also be played at any time, though they won't collect letters if they are already lit.

Letters in Boba Fett's name are also referred to as respect levels, and +2 Respect Level can be collected from a late-game Wild Space award.

In the original Pinball FX2 and Pinball FX3 releases of the table, Boba Fett had to be spelled in its entirety at the start of the game. This was changed in the Pinball FX reboot to make it easier to access the unique bounties.

469167.overview:
Star Wars Rebels is a pinball adaptation of the 2014 animated television series of the same name, as one of two tables in the Unsung Heroes pack for Zen Pinball and Pinball FX2 / FX3 / FX. 

Based primarily on the series' first season and the four shorts released to promote it, this table recounts the humble beginnings of a small band of rebels on the backwater planet of Lothal as they resist the tyranny of the Galactic Empire, which supplanted the Galactic Republic, persecuted the Jedi and oppressed many across the galaxy during and after the events of Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith.

469168.overview:
Star Wars: The Clone Wars is one of the first three Star Wars pinball tables released for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX 2 in 2013. 

Based on the 2008 animated television series of the same name, created by George Lucas and set between the events of Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones and Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith, it recounts the daring exploits of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, his Padawan apprentice Ahsoka Tano and esteemed Clone Captain CT-7567 "Rex" in the Clone Wars, in which the Jedi lead countless clone armies to defend the Republic from the Separatists and the Sith.

469169.overview:
Lead AC Milan to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots. The Milan table also features a rendition of "Milan Milan" as its unique theme music.

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469170.overview: Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi is a digital pinball table based on the 2017 film of the same name, released as part of the The Last Jedi DLC pack of pinball tables in 2018 for Pinball FX3. The table depicts the events of the second film in the Star Wars sequel trilogy, as the Resistance continues the fight against Kylo Ren & Captain Phasma while Rey struggles and comes to accept the power of the Force at a time where the Jedi have fallen.

469172.overview:
Star Trek is a physical pinball table designed by Steve Ritchie, illustrated by Greg Freres, Kevin O'Connor, and John Youssi, and programmed by Lonnie Ropp, Tanio Klyce, and Waison Cheng. It was released in 2013 by Stern Pinball, making it the fourth licensed Star Trek pinball machine.

Based on the J. J. Abrams' Star Trek reboot, this game focuses on various highlights from both Star Trek (2009) and Star Trek Into Darkness. Players will battle the rogue Romulan Nero and destroy his planet-busting drill, rescue Spock from an active volcano, battle Klingons alongside the mysterious John Harrison, then perform a Space Jump to the Vengeance and Save the Enterprise. 

The playfield itself is dominated by the Vengeance, which launches pinballs at the player, along with color-changing LED indicator lights, a Warp ramp, and a torpedo-launching Fire Button for the player. Make it through the Kobayashi Maru, the Klingon Multiball, battles with the Vengeance, and all eighteen game modes, and you'll have a chance to prove your worth in the Five Year Mission.

In addition to the basic "Starfleet Pro" model, the game is also available in "Vengeance Premium Edition" and "Enterprise Limited Edition" tables. The more advanced models include different backbox translites, more elaborate metalwork and cabinet molding, metal trails instead of plastic ramps, more elaborate LED lighting, color-changing playfield inserts, a vertical up-kicker and a kickback, and a Starfield laser projector.

The Vengeance Premium Edition was recreated as a digital table for FarSight Studios' title "The Pinball Arcade".

469182.overview:
Star Wars: Starfighter Assault is a pinball table based on the intense starfighter battles during the Galactic Civil War era of Star Wars history as one of a multitude of Star Wars Zen Pinball tables available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX2, Pinball FX3 and Pinball FX. 

This table is one of the three tables in the Balance of the Force pack and provides an opportunity to command and manage a fleet of Rebel or Imperial ships in the Galactic Civil War, fighting to either liberate or conquer the galaxy.

469190.overview:
Star Wars: Battle of Mimban is a pinball table that takes inspiration from and expands on an early scene from the 2018 Star Wars anthology film Solo: A Star Wars Story, released for Pinball FX 3 and the macOS version of Zen Pinball 2 as part of the Solo: A Star Wars Story DLC pack in 2018. 

The table gives players the opportunity to command a heavy-duty Imperial army in quashing an uprising on the mud planet of Mimban, where the young Han Solo discovers Chewbacca and begins his journey across the galaxy as a smuggler.

469191.overview:
Star Wars: Droids is a digital pinball table dedicated to famous droids in the Star Wars saga. It is one of the four tables in the Heroes Within pack for the Zen Pinball series.

The table is loosely based on C-3PO and R2-D2's time in captivity aboard a Jawa sandcrawler in a brief portion of the film Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope and their efforts to escape while encountering other captured droids along the way. This table's title is not to be confused with the 1985 animated television series of the same title.

469261.overview:
Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope is a pinball table based on the 1977 film of the same title, originally released as part of the Star Wars Pinball: Heroes Within DLC pack for Zen Pinball 2 & Pinball FX 2 in April 2014. This table re-enacts iconic and pivotal scenes in the first Star Wars film ever released, in which a brave Rebel Alliance races against time to destroy the tyrannical Galactic Empire's planet-destroying space station, the Death Star.

The goal of this table is to help the Rebel Alliance destroy the Galactic Empire's powerful Death Star in six missions. To start a mission, the player must spell REBEL on the return lanes to activate the post at the left orbit, then shoot that lane to choose a mission using the flippers and launch button. All missions are timed, and must be completed successfully without losing the ball to qualify the wizard mode. Successfully completed missions cannot be repeated again until the wizard mode is activated. Missions are split into several timed phases, but no checkpoints are given in between failed phases.

The reward for completing a mission starts at 5 million points. Every time REBEL is spelled at the return lanes during a mission, the reward will increase by 5 million points to a max of 50 million. Spelling REBEL once the mission reward is at maximum will score 1 million points.

469262.overview: Star Wars: Calrissian Chronicles is a pinball table based on the character Lando Calrissian's appearances in various Star Wars media under the most recent continuity. It was released for Pinball FX3 as part of the Solo: A Star Wars Story DLC pack in September 2018. The table explores the various adventures of Lando Calrissian, a smuggler turned general of the Rebel Alliance and an old friend of Han Solo during the reign and eventual fall of the Galactic Empire.

469264.overview:
Solo: A Star Wars Story is one of the three Pinball FX3 tables that adapts the events of the eponymous 2018 Star Wars anthology film, Solo: A Star Wars Story. This table takes the closest inspiration from the film, following the misadventures of a young Han Solo as he journeys into the criminal underworld and joins a crew to pull off a daring heist.

The goal of this table is to help Han Solo pull off his first heist in the criminal underworld through eight missions representing major scenes from Solo: A Star Wars Story. Each mission has its own start procedure and must be completed to unlock Kessel Run, which must then be completed to unlock the wizard mode, Showdown. Missions can be repeated to increase the jackpots in the wizard mode by 1 million, even after they are initially completed.

469265.overview:
Star Wars: Might of the First Order is a digital pinball table designed by Zoltan Vari, inspired by the seventh Star Wars installment, The Force Awakens. 

This table is one of two tables in the The Force Awakens pack and depicts the rise and military might of the First Order, a military group that seeks to destroy Resistance members.

The goal of this table is to help the First Order begin their attack on the Resistance through nine objectives - two Multiball modes, six single-ball modes, and one timed scoring feature. Each objective has its own unique activation method, and single-ball modes must be completed successfully without losing the ball to progress towards the wizard mode, Rule the Universe. Successfully completed single-ball modes increase in value each time they are completed, and can be repeated for increased wizard mode rewards (except for Capture Poe, which can only be started once per wizard mode run).

All timed missions can be started at any time during single-ball play, and if a Multiball mode is brought into a timed mission, the mission timer will freeze until Multiball play has ended. The one exception to the former rule is Prisoner Escaped, as it can only be started after Capture Poe has been played and will take priority over that mission for the rest of the current wizard mode run.

469283.overview:
Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back is one of the three tables in the original Star Wars Pinball DLC pack for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, later ported to Pinball FX3 and Pinball FX. The table is based on the 1981 film of the same name, depicting the Rebel Alliance's struggles to defeat the Empire at a time of immense crisis across the galaxy.

Relive the events of The Empire Strikes Back by playing all six scenes. To start a scene mission, the player must shoot the STAR & WARS standup targets once each, then shoot into the center sinkhole. If the targets aren't currently active, shooting the left ramp will raise them. The player can then select any mission they desire using the flippers and launch button.

The missions on this table are split into different sections; each completed section acts as a checkpoint in case the player fails the next part of the mission, and a bonus score is collected upon reaching checkpoints worth a base value of 10 million points + 500,000 per shot to the STAR & WARS standup targets across all missions. All mission sections are timed for either 60, 40, or 30 seconds, with each successful shot during 30-second missions adding 5 seconds to the timer, and the timer stops if the ball is in the bumpers. All six missions must be successfully completed to light the Grand Finale wizard mode at the left orbit. Winning three scenes lights an extra ball.

469284.overview:
Countdown to launch! Blast through orbiting satellites and space stations in this classic space mission table.

Space Shuttle is a classic solid-state pinball machine released by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1980. It is often praised for its vibrant space exploration-themed artwork and a playfield layout that rivals or exceeds many contemporary American machines. It features a depiction of the Enterprise shuttle and an astronaut with a pink helmet, four pop bumpers, drop targets, and two kick-out holes.

469291.overview:
Lead Juventus FC to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots. The Juventus table also features the club's theme music "Storia Di Un Grande Amore".

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469292.overview:
Lead FC Barcelona to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots. The Barcelona table also features the club's official theme song "Cant del Barça".

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469295.overview:
Lead Real Madrid CF to glory against the world's finest football clubs! Guide them in their quest to become Super League Champions.

There were eight different versions of the Super League Football pinball table available to purchase as DLC for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, including seven officially licensed teams. The tables all have exactly the same layout and gameplay, but feature different team colours, branding and mascots.

Each game of pinball you play is one league match against a rival team, and progress is saved between games to create a full league season of ten matches with the overall aim of finishing Super League champions.

469383.overview:
Fasten your seatbelt! Soar across Europe at full throttle on a high-speed journey between London and Paris. Jet engines roar, afterburners blaze, and every mission brings you closer to the ultimate transcontinental triumph.

Supersonic is a classic electro-mechanical pinball table produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1977. The table features a supersonic flight theme, heavily inspired by the Concorde aircraft. The backglass and playfield showcase vivid, European-style cartoon artwork with a "groovy 60s vibe," despite its late 70s release.

Players aim to complete flights from London and Paris to New York by hitting specific targets. Successfully lighting the word "New York" allows the player to earn an extra ball by hitting a center target. The table includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, slingshots, and an inner/outer orbit layout. It is noted for its high difficulty and frequent "insta-drains" into the outlanes due to its fast and challenging layout.

Supersonic is famously described as a "backwards hybrid." While most American games of 1977 were moving toward digital scoring with chimes, this machine pairs traditional score reels with early digital electronic sounds, creating a distinct sensory experience for players.

469389.overview:
Step into the glitz and glamour! Bright light, big wins, and endless excitement define the Star's Phoenix casino experience.

Released in 1987, Star's Phoenix is a notable and rare solid-state pinball machine from the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria. It is historically significant as the company's first multiball game, and was produced just before Zaccaria's bankruptcy and subsequent reorganization into "Mr. Game". The table features a muddled mix of bowling (prominent on the backglass) and casino/gambling (seen on the playfield).

The first production version featured a purple cabinet, while the second version, renamed New Star's Phoenix, had a black cabinet, different artwork and a fourth flipper. Due to the factory’s imminent closure at the time of release, production numbers were very small, making it one of the hardest Zaccaria machines for collectors to find.

469558.overview:
Flip to the death in the depths of space. Guide the Hacker through Citadel Station infested with cyborgs, mutants, and reprogrammed robots to defeat SHODAN.

Table Features:

- Jack into the Cyberspace Terminal mini-playfield for great rewards
- Watch out for the Cyborg Attack! If you take too long to shoot, your ball will be shot and jettisoned off your flipper
- Shoot with precision to 'Get a Head'. Reveal a second ball by hitting the correct one out of three severed heads
- It's a Mutant Menace! Hit all the enemies and escape by the elevator
- Brave all perils of the table to initiate self-destruct and defeat SHODAN for good

470303.overview:
A digital pinball table released for Visual Pinball based upon Yacht Club Games' retro styled platformer, Shovel Knight.

Modes:

• Hit any shot to progress toward lighting a mode. The more modes that have been played, the more shots will be needed to light a mode. • When a mode is lit, shoot the right saucer which will be lit with a blue shovel.
• During modes, hit flashing targets and shots with blue shovels. Doing well in modes will earn medals.
• After nine modes have been played, the next mode will be the Enchantress wizard mode, which is a time limited multiball. The better your medals are, the more time you will have in Enchantress mode

Shovel Knight Multiball:

• Hit the green S-H-O-V-E-L and K-N-I-G-H-T targets to light locks. Lock two balls under the ramps, then shoot the right saucer which will be lit with a green shovel.
• During Shovel Knight multiball, hit the yellow, orange, and red shots for jackpots. Complete the green S-H-O-V-E-L and K-N-I-G-H-T targets to light a super jackpot at the violet shot at the upper playfield hole. The second and third super jackpots will be double and triple super jackpots, but the upper playfield becomes increasingly difficult to access.

Wanderer Multiball:

• Hit the bumpers, the spinner, or the upper playfield hole to light Wanderer Multiball at the turquoise shot at the upper playfield hole.
• During Wanderer Multiball, hit turquoise shots or targets to build the wanderer jackpot. When the wanderer jackpot is at least 10,000 points, it can be collected at the turquoise shot at the center VUK.
• After collecting jackpots from four different wanderers, the next Wanderer Multiball will be a Super Wanderer Multiball.

Shot Multipliers:

• Complete the white lights at the inlanes and outlanes to enable a 2X multiplier for 60 seconds at the next shot you make.
• When a shot has a multiplier active, the “X” light under the shovel light for a shot will blink. When the multiplier has expired, the “X” light will be lit red, and that shot cannot be multiplied again until all shots have used multipliers.
• Multiplying the left loop also affects the scoring for the bumpers. Multiplying the right loop also affects the scoring for the spinner. Any shot that is multiplied counts as two shots towards lighting modes.
• The shot that enables the multiplier is not affected by it. If you want to double your super jackpot, the upper playfield hole needs to be doubled before lighting the super jackpot.
• After a 2X multiplier has been used on all ten shots, the right saucer will be lit with a white shovel, and shooting it will start Hall of Champions mode. Win Hall of Champions mode by completing all ten shots in time. During Hall of Champions, all shots have a 2X multiplier.

Combos:

• Hit consecutive yellow shots to increase the combo value. Collect the combo value at the orange shot at the left loop. After every 12th combo, all combo values will be tripled for 30 seconds.

470432.overview:
The upgraded mission begins! Improved graphics and smoother flow elevate this space classic to new heights.

Space Shuttle 2016 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1980 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2016 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470433.overview:
Haunted horror hits a new high! Deluxe graphics and spine-chilling effects make this spooky table unforgettable.

Spooky Deluxe is a digital reimagining by Magic Pixel of the 1987 solid-state Zaccaria table with modern pinball features such as LCD display, prism lamps and game and multiball modes. It was released as DLC in 2020 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470434.overview:
Cosmic power unleashed! New challenges and starry wonders take this space epic to new heights.

Star God 2019 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1980 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2019 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470730.overview:
Get ready for the most epic Sonic pinball table ever created... and a pinball game like you've never seen before!

This has everything a Sonic fan could want in one table. Green Hill zone scenery, Sonic Loop ramp, animated bumpers, springs, item box, checkpoint, chaos emerald flashers, red star spinner, launch tunnel, rotating goal sign, moving robots, animated characters such as Sonic / Knuckles / Shadow... and even Dr Robotnik and his eggmobile which will follow your ball with it's spotlight... and much more!

This table takes full advantage of BAM's latest features with full dynamic lighting and ray cast shadows and shadowmaps to create a stunning visual pinball showcase!

What started as a quick BAM mod to update Brendan Bailey's classic Sonic table of 2005 (which was updated by SLAMT1LT in 2014), evolved into a complete overhaul to the entire table. Everything in the table has either been updated or changed, and TerryRed has added so many new things (new layout, art, models, lighting, modes, code, fixes, etc) that it's like a new table. Hence... Sonic Pinball Mania.

This table has been fully updated with FizX physics for game changing new physics on Future Pinball. FizX uses techniques similar to nFozzy physics on VPX to completely change the physics for the flippers, slings, rubbers, targets, ball behavior and more that allows this table play much more realistically than anyone ever thought was possible on Future Pinball. You will be amazed at the difference!

471122.overview: Based upon the David Bowie track from 1969, Space Oddity is a re-theme of Williams' 1987 pinball table "Space Station" for Visual Pinball X.

471260.overview:
It's Scooby Doo, 2022. A lot has changed since 1969, but Shaggy, Scooby and the rest of the gang need your help to capture eight monsters & ghosts and to solve this mystery.

This table is a Visual Pinball X retrofit, retheme and remaster by mrjcrane of the 2018 VP9 original table Scooby Doo, by Maslaja and JP Salas. The audio track has been entirely re-mastered and the table is running on the superior VPX platform with better code and a more streamlined game play.

This table has no connection to the Spooky Pinball "Scooby-Doo! Where Are You?" physical table from 2022.

471600.overview:
Speed Devils is one of the four iconic pinball tables featured in Pinball Fantasies, developed by Digital Illusions (later DICE) and released in 1992. It is a high-octane, fast-paced table with a motorsports theme, requiring players to master speed and timing to succeed. The primary goal is to simulate a car race by hitting targets, changing gears, and using ramps to overtake cars, ultimately aiming to reach top speed and take the lead position.

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by users "LvR" & "Moog" for Future Pinball in 2009.

471638.overview:
Steel Wheel is one of the four original tables featured in the seminal 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions. Themed around the Old West and steam-powered trains, it is considered the most accessible table for beginners among the four, featuring a welcoming design with accessible ramps.

The table features a brown and grey color scheme, with graphics focusing on steam trains, wild west imagery, and a banjo-heavy soundtrack. The layout of Steel Wheel is primarily based on the 1989 Williams "Bad Cats" real-world pinball table. The gameplay revolves around hitting the left and center ramps repeatedly to build up massive points and ticket values.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by Misaligned Cow Venture, in addition to a Special Edition featuring more modern table artwork.

471816.overview: SLAMT1LT's enhanced version for Future Pinball transforms Bally's 1978 early solid-state era table into a highly playable modern digital pinball experience. It features actual bowling pins to knock down instead of rollover buttons, a bowling ball, and music and callouts from the 1998 movie "The Big Lebowski".

471824.overview:
A long time ago (2005) on a pinball editor far, far away... this table started its long journey.

First it started as the Sci-Fi Classic example table for Future Pinball in 2005. Then SLAMT1LT created his Star Wars mod in 2010, which then evolved over the years to his Ultra version, then his Ultimate version, then finally his Ultimate Pro 1.06 version in 2020. TerryRed then updated that table with his Epic Space Battles mod in 2021, and then for PinEvent afterward.

Most recently, in 2022, TerryRed released his massive GALACTIC EDITION update. This table has been completely updated and modernized to use the newest BAM features to create an amazing real-time visual treat that will blow you away! Almost everything you saw before has been updated to the max (or replaced) and many cool new additions have been added!

471844.overview:
Stones 'n Bones is the fourth and final table in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Fantasies, developed by Digital Illusions. It features a spooky, gothic horror theme complete with ghosts, bats, and a dark atmosphere.

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by user light86 for Future Pinball.

471992.overview: Based on Sega's classic beat 'em up series, this table is a mod of Brendan Bailey's Metal Slug table for Visual Pinball X.

472037.overview:
An original table by Marty02 for Visual Pinball X. The goal of the game is to help Superman reform the Justice League by completing 12 missions, plus 3 Boss missions and 3 bonus missions.

The table features 4 multiball modes, music and voices from the films and TV series, multiple jackpots, extra balls, multiplier bonuses and much more.

472169.overview: A mod by Polygame of the Future Pinball recreation of Steel Wheel. Featuring completely overhauled graphics, a slightly more developed playfield layout, but crucially boasting exactly the same gameplay, music and sound effects of the original, this Special Edition is a treat for fans of the Pinball Dreams classic.

472230.overview: An original table for Visual Pinball X featuring a huge amount of highly offensive audio from the TV show and multiple missions to complete.

472344.overview:
A special edition of the classic digital table, with updated graphics and 3D models.

Speed Devils was created by Digital Illusions for Pinball Fantasies on the Commodore Amiga in 1992, and then recreated by users LvR and Moog for Future Pinball in 2009. The Special Edition was released by Polygame in 2010, as a graphical / playfield mod of the 2009 table.

472348.overview:
Squid Game is a South Korean dystopian survival thriller drama television series created, written, and directed by Hwang Dong-hyuk for Netflix. The series revolves around a secret contest where 456 players, all of whom are in deep financial hardship, risk their lives to play a series of children's games that result in death if eliminated, for the chance to win a ₩45.6 billion (US$39.86 million) prize.

This table for Visual Pinball X is a graphics and sounds mod of Marty02's Men In Black Trilogy table.

472396.overview: Enhanced version of Bally's 1979 Star Trek machine with added music, sound effects, and dialogue from the TV show, a modern mode and an original mode, and small tweaks to the rules and gameplay.

472397.overview:
SLAMT1LT's enhanced version of Stern's 2013 Star Trek machine includes videos from the J.J. Abrams-directed films, additional sound effects, new features and different rules to Stern's table. There are 12 main story missions in total from 6 movie scenerios; 2 main multiballs (Vengeance and Klingon); 2 Captain Chair mission modes; 3 special features (Super Pops, Super Spinner and Super Ramps) and 1 Vengeance scoring hurry up.

MISSIONS: 

Shoot the flashing Trek Arrows. When only 1 more shot is needed, all 6 Trek Arrows will flash and any shot will win. Progess is saved for each mission. The player can resume where they left off next time the same mission is started.

VENGEANCE MULTIBALL:

3 balls are immediately fired from the Vengenace.  Destroy the Vengeance by either hitting it directly or by using a torpedo (Punch It). Torpedoes can be acquired in the normal way (complete the 3 Power Targets on the right). When Vengeance has been destroyed, both orbit lanes and both ramps will score Vengeance Jackpots.  Centre shots to the Vengenace will score Super Vengeance Jackpots when lit.

KLINGON MULTIBALL:

2 balls are fired from the Klingon ship.  Extinquish all the flashing ship targets (Jackpots) to light the Super Jackpot in the Warp Kicker or Vengeance Kicker.  Get the Super Jackpot and then hit the Warp kicker or Vengenance Kicker again (combo) to get the Double Super Jackpot.  Clear the Jackpots a third time and hit the Warp Kicker or Vengeance kicker for the Super Klingon Jackpot (50m)

CAPTAIN'S CHAIR MISSION # 1: KOBYASHI MARU:

When all first tier modes are completed, the Captain's Chair will light and Kobyashi Maru mode will begin.  All 6 Trek Arrows will flash, shoot them for Mission Jackpots.  Clear all the Mission Jackpots and the Kobyashi Maru Jackpots will light (ship arrows).

CAPTAIN'S CHAIR MISSION # 2: GENESIS:

The crew experience an anomaly during Warp and are sent 30 years into the future.  They must use the Genesis devise to return their youth.

ORBIT PLAYER CONTROL:

The left and right orbits are controlled by the player.  Hold down the left flipper to stop the ball completing a left orbit
or hold down the right flipper to stop the ball completing a right orbit.  In both cases the ball will drop into the multiplier rollover lanes. Release both flippers if you want the ball to complete either orbit.

CAMPAIGN MEDALS

Bronze, Silver and Gold Medals can be earned during each mission:

- Bronze: Make any 3 mission shots
- Silver: Make the Away Team shot after winning bronze
- Gold: Complete the mode at the first attempt

VICTORY MEDALS

Win for collecting the Vengance Super Jackpot; beating the highest score and beating the game.

EXTRA BALLS

- for getting a total score of 200 million or more
- for reaching Warp 10
- as a random Black Hole mystery award (black hole will detect a poor player and offer assistance)

473075.overview: SLAMT1LT's enhanced version of Stern's 1980 pinball table is a relaxing experience with calming sea sounds and chilled music to accompany the gameplay.

473174.overview: This fast-playing version of Stern's 2007 pinball machine has several additions, including a video screen, a switchable backglass, five different soundtracks, extra sound effects, and new playfield toys.

473326.overview:
Released in July 2006, this table is the first release by Antzero Productions (Anthias and Subzero). The table features music and graphics from Sega's classic aracde rail shooter, multiball, and warp holes to teleport the ball around the table.

It requires an older version of the Future Pinball loader to run (e.g. FuturePinball23.exe), as newer versions will cause graphical glitches.

473504.overview:
Released in October 1978, Bally's The Six Million Dollar Man is a classic solid-state pinball machine based on the hit 1970s television series starring Lee Majors. Designed by Greg Kmiec with striking artwork by Dave Christensen, this highly popular machine—which sold 10,320 units—remains famous for its patriotic aesthetic and unique 6-player gameplay capability.

Recreated for Visual Pinball X by allknowing2012, this sound mod by Xenonph adds music, speech and bionic sound effects from the TV show, to make an already excellent table even more fun to play.

474144.overview: A Star Wars mod of Roney Pinball's Galaxia table for Future Pinball, themed around the huge battle from the 1980 movie, The Empire Strikes Back.

474234.overview:
Space Mission: ULTRA Edition is SLAMT1LT's mod of the best-selling 1976 Williams "Space Mission" electro-mechanical pinball table, built specifically for Future Pinball. It transforms the vintage, chime-based gameplay into a more immersive, cinematic experience by leveraging the capabilities of advanced pinball simulators.

The remaster leans heavily into the table’s retro-futuristic, Apollo-era space exploration theme by completely overhauling the audio landscapes. The ULTRA Edition replaces the silence of the original 1976 table with driving, synthesizer-heavy electronic music, and adds ambient cosmic drones that escalate in intensity during high-stakes modes.

477248.overview:
An original table for Future Pinball by SLAMT1LT based on the 1980 movie Superman II, featuring video clips, sound effects and music. 

The aim of the table is to fight and banish 3 Supervilians to the Phantom Zone.  You will face them individually (missions) and collectively (multi-ball). Activate each mission by lighting S-U-P-E-R.  When you defeat the Supervilian by completing the timed objective, you then have the opportunity to score a big bonus by banishing them to the Phantom Zone. You do this by hitting the Chamber Kicker after each successful mission.

479639.overview:
Francisco666 and Rom's Future Pinball recreation of the 1993 Williams table gets a 20th Anniversary makeover, courtesy of SLAMT1LT.

20th Anniversary Edition Features:

 • All new soundtrack from composers James Horner and Jerry Goldsmith.
 • Remastered sound samples recorded by the original cast.
 • New sound effects taken from the TV show.
 • New interactive HUD computer to change settings on the fly.
 • Improved lighting and many other tweaks.

479983.overview:
JP's version of Street Fighter II for Visual Pinball X modernises Gottlieb's 1993 table by giving it a visual facelift, featuring new artwork, enhanced 4K textures, improved dynamic lighting, and custom 3D character figures.

 • Texture Resolution: JP's version upgrades older low-res playfield and plastic scans to brand new crisp 4K-ready assets.
 • 3D Elements: Replaces flat picture inserts with custom 3D character figures on the playfield.
 • Lighting and Shadows: Adds advanced environment reflections, dynamic flasher effects, and adjustable Look-Up Table (LUT) lighting levels to control brightness and ambient shadows under the glass (hold down LEFT CTRL and change levels with RIGHT CTRL).
 • Mechanical Polish: Includes new elements like the neon "FIGHTER" lights.

480075.overview: Felsir's mod of JP's Street Fighter II table for Visual Pinball X replaces Gottlieb's original playfield graphics with modern Street Fighter artwork.

480588.overview:
Shooting the Rapids Deluxe takes Zaccaria's classic Shooting the Rapids table from 1979 to thrilling new heights, combining the nostalgic spirit of the original with modern enhancements and cutting-edge pinball action. 

Themed around Native American culture and canoeing adventures, paddle through roaring waters guided by the spirits of nature as you explore sacred rivers and hidden trails. Conquer unique challenges like Rapid Combo, Spirit Rapids and the mighty Echo of the Totem. Test your skill in exhilarating modes such as Arrow, Axe, Bear, Hawk and Wolf, and unlock three mystical mini-games: Sun, Wind and Moon. 

Native legends spring to life with features like Tomahawk Spin, Net Bonus and the adrenaline-charged Indian Multiball. This table fuses rich cultural motifs with fast-paced gameplay for an unforgettable ride down the rapids!

480597.overview: Siggi's graphical mod of The Sopranos (Stern, 2005) for Visual Pinball X gives the game a completely new look, with changes to the playfield artwork, plastics, backwall, and textures.

480609.overview:
Spirit of '76 (Gottlieb, 1975) is an iconic electro-mechanical pinball machine, designed to celebrate the upcoming U.S. Bicentennial. With a production run of 10,569 units, the machine was a big commercial success. The game was designed by the legendary Ed Krynski, featuring distinct patriotic artwork by Gordon Morison that prominently incorporates American history alongside space exploration (including John Glenn, Apollo spacecraft, and minutemen).

The recreation for Future Pinball was made by Popette, and SLAMT1LT's ULTRA Edition gives bckground music options not present in the original game, including James Brown's 1985 pop hit "Living in America" during the table's attract mode.

480629.overview:
Spy vs. Spy is a unique table first released for Future Pinball in 2010. Based on the classic MAD Magazine comic strip featuring the rival Black and White spies in an espionage setting, the game is a two player competitive affair, or one player vs the computer.

Spy vs. Spy was the first table created by RAWD, who sadly passed away on 26th August 2026, and an updated version with modern features like FizX physics, BAM lighting and shadows was released the following day by TerryRed to honour his memory.

480675.overview:
Jipar's tribute to Taito's classic shooting game features ten rows of alien drop targets at the top of the playfield that players must 'shoot' to destroy, à la the original Space Inavders arcade game.

Released for Future Pinball in 2013, the game has a fairly simple ruleset:

 • Hit special targets: 
-Blue: to enable 'LOOPS'
-Red: to shoot 4 UFO targets (on left or right side)
-Green: to enter 'kickers' (left or right)
-Purple: to hit BUMPER 1 or 2.

 • When the 4 lights are completed, shoot 1 special target to get the JACKPOT + X-BALL.

 • Hit the 3 pink targets gives high score, and X-Ball when all special targets are down.

 • 10 KICKERS (left or right) enable X-BALL.

480903.overview: Space Invaders II for Future Pinball is an original table that features an interactive game of Space Invaders in the middle of the playfield. Players must hit the Space Invaders with the ball to kill them, and in later waves use the left and right flippers to move the ship from side-to-side to avoid the Invaders' fire.

480985.overview: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for Future Pinball is a classic virtual pinball table originally created by Brendan Bailey in 2005, later modernized and significantly expanded into community projects like Sonic the Hedgehog: ULTIMATE Edition (SLAMT1LT, 2014) and Sonic Pinball Mania (TerryRed, 2022). The table was ported to Visual Pinball X in 2019 by Javier1515.

480987.overview:
Sonic the Hedgehog: ULTIMATE Edition is an enhanced version of Brendan Bailey's Sonic the Hedgehog 2 table for Future Pinball. Developed by SLAMT1LT around 2014, the update adds custom audio, a Dot Matrix Display (DMD), upgrades the visuals, and makes various code enhancements to improve gameplay. 

This version was built upon by TerryRed to create his Sonic Pinball Mania table, which was released in 2022.

481001.overview:
Step into the eerie world of Stephen King's Pet Sematary with a terrifying pinball experience! Can you uncover the dark secrets of the cursed burial ground and escape before it's too late? This horror-filled machine brings spine-chilling excitement, supernatural surprises, and edge of your seat gameplay.

Pet Sematary for Visual Pinball X is a re-theme of Dracule (Stern, 1979) and is inspired by the 1989 movie adaptation of Stephen King's 1983 horror novel.
